angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 29,080,260 km at 35477.40 pc = 0.01 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 12717: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 35477.4 +/- 3676.3 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 35477.4 +/- 3676.3 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.0147 +/- 0.0171 mas (same row, RUWE 1.05), 0.9 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 41.8 +/- 4.4 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 12717: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 41.8 +/- 4.4 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 29,080,260 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5750 +/- 125 K from Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC0046, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5750 +/- 125 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC0046, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5750 +/- 125 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 1.49 from 2020AJ....160..120J; the 3 published values span log g 1.396 to 2.45, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.8% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..120J)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
